newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields fall on 182-day Lithuanian T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on 182-day Lithuanian T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on 182-day Treasury bills at Tuesday's auction and all of the 40 million litas issue was sold as it was oversubscribed, the central bank said.
The average yield was 11.28 percent, down from the 11.91 percent offered at the last auction for 182-day paper on April 1.
The settlement date is April 11 and the bills mature October 10.
All figures in millions of litas with the exception of yields and days.
